description.summary: You play a soft ballad, causing a creature to become immobilized.
description.value: You play a soft ballad, causing a creature to become immobilized. Each round this song is in effect, an creature within 30 feet of the bard suffers the Immobilized status effect. Immobilized: This status effect causes the creature to be unable to move normally. An immobilized creature cannot move, but may do other actions (attack, cast, etc.) provided he can do those actions not requiring him to move and has no penalty to AC.
